verdict.rationale: Snyk documents multi-ecosystem coverage (Open Source dependency scanning across package managers, Snyk Code SAST, Container, and IaC for Terraform/CloudFormation/Kubernetes/ARM) and a CLI that runs across languages, but no explicit list of which languages/package managers are supported is given, and community feedback raises accuracy concerns (mismatched results vs npm audit, missed versions) that temper confidence in comprehensive, precise coverage. missing for 10: explicit enumerated language/ecosystem support matrix, independent benchmark of breadth/accuracy across ecosystems, resolution of community-reported discrepancies with native audit tools.
